beats.say: Under one thousand followers? Start your email list now, for free, with a tool called Kit.
Make a sign-up page, offer a free guide, and send your first email.
The honest limit: the free plan has no automated email sequences. Those start on the Creator plan, at thirty-three dollars a month.
Free alternative: collect emails with a free form, like Google Forms, and email people yourself. Fine for your first hundred.

show.text: Free alternative: a *Google Form* + manual emails
